entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.45918 of 2022
Order:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and the and the learned Standing Counsel for Singareni Collieries Company Ltd.,

2. The Petitioner in this Writ Petition is questioning the action of the respondents in not including his name for extending the benefits of G.O.Ms.No.68 (I&CAD) dated 08.04.2005, with regard to Rehabilitation and Resettlement package under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the subject matter involved in this writ petition is squarely covered by the Order passed by this Court in W.P.No.38740 of 2017 and batch dated 21.12.2022 and requested to pass similar order in this writ petition.
The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition as well as the learned Standing Counsel for the Singareni Collieries did not dispute the same.

4. In view of the submissions made by both sides, the respondents are directed to take immediate steps for considering the case of the petitioner for extending the said benefits of Rehabilitation and Resettlement package and to conclude the said proceedings within a period of three (03) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, in accordance with law, duly taking into consideration the law laid down by this Court in W.P.No.24233 of 2015 and batch, dated 01.08.2018.
Petitioner is granted liberty to place a copy of the order dated 01.08.2018, before the respondents.
5. In view of the above, this writ petition is disposed of as indicated above.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
